displayTitle: Askeladden Who Had an Eating Match with the Troll
description: “Chop in my forest and I’ll kill you!” The troll has sent both of Askeladden’s brothers running home, but Askeladden heads into the forest with nothing in his knapsack but a little homemade cheese. A cheeky Norwegian classic, told in lively modern English.
summary: Askeladden bluffs a forest troll with a cheese and a knapsack full of porridge, and carries home gold to pay off some of the family debt.
